summary: John's 3rd great-grandfather; Irish-born, in Schuylkill County by 1857 and Plymouth by 1860.
bio: Martin Murphy, born c.1835 in Ireland, had a child born in Schuylkill Co. in Feb 1857, was in Plymouth by 1860, and in Plymouth Twp. in 1870 and 1880. He died 8 May 1885.
